laws.name: authority non-amplification
laws.reopen: authority algebra or external-source contract changes

laws.name: warrant/source conservation
laws.scope: registered support antichains, dependence flattening and nogoods
laws.reopen: warrant algebra or contradiction semantics changes

laws.name: fast/slow fixed-point stability
laws.scope: nonnegative row-substochastic restart kernels, l1 seeds <=1, fixed alpha in (0,1]
laws.reopen: normalization, signed kernels, nonlinear dynamics or alpha semantics change

laws.name: epistemic hysteresis/reversibility
laws.scope: append-only evidence identities; quarantine-preserving structural rollback
laws.reopen: history deletion, external effects, evidence identity or structural rollback protocol changes

laws.name: epistemic persistence/viability
laws.scope: registered safe predicate, revision envelope and admissible epistemic actions
laws.reopen: typed epistemic safe set yields a theorem not reducible to parent controlled invariance

laws.name: commuting abstraction/structural change
laws.scope: finite quotient kernels plus warrant/answer measurability; conservative extension on registered queries
laws.reopen: future multiscale object not representable as finite projection/conservative extension

laws.name: multi-agent non-laundering
laws.reopen: quantitative fusion without explicit coupling/independence model

laws.name: self-model separation
laws.scope: registered K_self boundary and external adoption protocol
laws.reopen: self-model receives object-world or commit write authority

laws.name: resource monotonicity/no-free-representation
laws.reopen: formal lower-bound theorem frozen for a natural family

laws.name: typed terminal completeness
laws.scope: finite registered transition grammars with declared budgets
laws.reopen: unbounded or asynchronous runtime semantics added
